notes: Original title and DOI verified against author-uploaded early online proof; cached source is browser-retrieved HTML article transcription, including article body; references tail truncated by browser response. Two-column transcription interleaves Experiments 2 and 3. Equality and minus-sign encoding artifacts normalized only in test_statistic. Original p. 3 locator matches Experiment 3. Replication cached title identifies the registered replication despite supplied withdrawn DOI metadata. Replication p < .001 is a heterogeneity test and p = .04 is a continuous-time regression, so neither is assigned to the .08 mean difference. Replication prose says other condition exceeds pooled no-delay, whereas its Discussion describes no-delay exceeding other conditions; retain printed positive .08 without repairing direction. Overall participant counts differ within the cached report.
